articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Indian Antitrust Push Tests Apple App Store Model And Valuation Narrative. India's Competition Commission is moving to a final hearing in a key antitrust case against Apple (NasdaqGS:AAPL) over its App Store rules. The regulator is accelerating the process after Apple reportedly did not supply certain required data. The case could lead to a multibillion dollar penalty calculated on Apple's global turnover and may influence how it runs its App Store in India.
